Every comfort need has a clear route.

Choose your mattress concept first.

Our collection follows one clear UK and European size system. First choose the mattress concept that matches your comfort needs. Then select the sizes available for that construction on its model page.

Together, the collection covers the full range of standard UK and European sizes. Some specialised constructions, including Mattress for Partners, begin from specific widths. Custom sizes, depths and special shapes can also be discussed with us.
